name: io.github.OniVe/weeeking
title: Weeeking
description: MCP server for Weeek with full public API coverage: tasks, projects, CRM, time tracking.

environmentVariables.name: WEEEK_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Weeek API token (Weeek: Settings → API). Alternative: store it with `weeeking store-token`.

environmentVariables.name: READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: true (default) — read-only mode: write tools are hidden. Set false to allow changes.

environmentVariables.name: WEEEK_LANG
environmentVariables.description: Language of user-facing texts: ru (default) or en — help, tool descriptions, prompts, errors.

environmentVariables.name: WEEEK_ALLOW_ACTIONS
environmentVariables.description: Absolute allow list of OpenAPI operation ids/masks (comma/space separated): anything not listed is forbidden; a set-but-empty value is a startup error. Cannot be combined with WEEEK_PROFILE.

environmentVariables.name: WEEEK_DENY_ACTIONS
environmentVariables.description: Deny list of OpenAPI operation ids/masks (e.g. delete-*): denied operations are hidden and rejected on call; a set-but-empty value is a startup error.

environmentVariables.name: WEEEK_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Ready access profile: executor — reads plus task and comment creation only.

environmentVariables.name: WEEEK_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Custom API base URL (proxy or self-hosted gateway).

environmentVariables.name: WEEEK_DISABLE_KEYCHAIN
environmentVariables.description: 1 — do not read the token from the system keychain (Credential Manager / Keychain / Secret Service).

environmentVariables.name: WEEEK_LOG
environmentVariables.description: debug — verbose HTTP logs to stderr (no token).
